description: Hand-checked source-to-C++ executable anchors for the u21434019 backend. Expected output strings are specified independently of the code generator.
target_dialect: C++17 (D01 proposal; tutor confirmation remains pending)

cases.purpose: Minimal checked program renders, compiles, and exits with no output.
Integer-looking operands must be divided in the selected floating numeric mode.
Modulo is exact integer arithmetic, in a distinct compilation from division.
The RHS is evaluated from the old value before assigning the destination.
Output order is stable, and print adds no implicit spaces or newline.

cases.source: : : if or ( not ( eq ( 1 1 ) ) eq ( 1 2 ) ) then { print "bad" ; } else { print "ok" ; } ;
cases.purpose: False Boolean paths must reach the false destination; a false OR not may not fall into the true branch.

cases.source: : : if and ( eq ( 1 1 ) or ( eq ( 1 2 ) not ( eq ( 1 2 ) ) ) ) then { print "t" ; } else { print "f" ; } ; if and ( eq ( 1 2 ) eq ( 1 1 ) ) then { print "t" ; } else { print "f" ; } ; if not ( or ( eq ( 1 2 ) eq ( 1 1 ) ) ) then { print "t" ; } else { print "f" ; } ;
cases.purpose: Nested AND/OR/NOT decisions are evaluated by explicit label transfers.
Pre-test while may execute its body zero times.
Post-test while always executes its body at least once.

cases.source: #x : : #x = 0 ; until eq ( 1 1 ) do { #x = add ( #x 1 ) ; } ; print ( #x ) ; #x = 0 ; do { #x = add ( #x 1 ) ; } until eq ( #x 1 ) ; print ( #x ) ;
cases.purpose: Pre-test until exits immediately when true, and post-test until exits after the first matching iteration.
